name: Lion
description: Lion optimizer factory. foreach, fused, and capturable execution are not claimed; DDP/FSDP/ZeRO compatibility matches a plain torch optimizer step on local parameters.

parameters.backend_options: forwarded to torch.optim.Lion when available; unsupported by fallback

examples.title: Minimize a quadratic bowl with Lion
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.lion import lion

params = [torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(3.0)), torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(-2.0))]
optimizer = lion(params, lr=0.05)
for _ in range(20):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss = sum((p - target).square() for p, target in zip(params, (1.0, 4.0)))
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
